requirements.text: Students can color-code modules in their timetables.
Students can hide cancelled classes from their timetables.
Students can add personal study blocks to their timetables.
Students can manage their notification preferences for grades and deadlines via a dedicated section in the portal.
Students can choose their preferred channels for notifications (email, SMS, in-app alerts).
Students can set how often they receive notifications for grades and deadlines.
The module feedback system should include questions about content quality.
The module feedback system should include questions about teaching delivery.
The module feedback system should include questions about resources provided.
The module feedback system should include a rating scale for overall satisfaction.
Feedback submitted by students must be completely anonymous.
Module coordinators should only access feedback after grades are submitted.
All new features must integrate with the existing portal's authentication system.
The existing student records database schema must not be modified.
All enhancements must comply with GDPR and the university's data retention policy.
